transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

I’m convinced certain people in my professional and art circles are secretly working together to damage my reputation and my practice, even though everyone keeps telling me it’s not really happening. It has become a really heavy weight to carry, and I just don't know what to do anymore.
Can you tell me more about these people you think are working against you, and have you experienced any other unusual thoughts or perceptions that seem real to you but others don't believe?

It's a specific group of clients and local art patrons from my professional and social circles. I'm convinced they have a quiet group chat or email chain dedicated to coordinating how to freeze me out and ruin my reputation. Whenever someone reschedules a meeting or doesn't reply to an email, that feeling becomes incredibly real to me, even though everyone tells me I'm just overthinking it.
Have you ever taken any actions or made decisions based on these beliefs about people working against you, such as confronting them or changing your behavior to try to counter their supposed plans?

I haven't confronted anyone directly, but I've drastically changed my behavior to avoid them, like cutting my work hours and canceling meetings last minute, which has unfortunately cost me several long-term clients. I also stopped going to my regular basketball games, cut trips short because I didn't feel safe, and now I completely avoid social events or seeing friends and family if I think those specific people might show up. It has just felt safer to stay isolated in my apartment.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts about people working against you, and have they been persistent or have there been periods where you didn't think about them at all?

It first started gradually about two years ago after a really difficult breakup, but it was more in the background back then. Over the last couple of months, though, it has become incredibly intense and constant, and I haven't had any breaks from these thoughts at all.

Can you describe if there have been any periods, even brief ones, where you questioned the reality of these beliefs about people working against you, or have they always felt completely true to you since they started?

Honestly, they have always felt completely real to me, and I haven't had any moments where I truly doubted it. Even when my sister or colleagues tell me I'm just overthinking things, I can't shake the feeling at all. To me, it just feels like an absolute fact that they are working together against me.

Have you experienced any significant changes in your mood, such as depression or mania, alongside these persistent thoughts of being targeted, or have your emotions remained relatively stable despite these beliefs?

I wouldn't say I experience extreme highs like mania, and it's not really typical sadness or depression either. Instead, I just feel completely flat, empty, and disconnected from everything around me. Most days I just sit in my apartment with the TV on mute, ignoring everyone and feeling like I'm just going through the motions.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people can't hear, or seen things that aren't really there, especially in relation to these beliefs about people working against you?

No, I haven't heard any voices or seen things that aren't actually there. For me, it has really just been this constant, overwhelming feeling that these specific people are actively working together to ruin me. That is the only thing I've been experiencing, but it feels completely real.
Can you tell me if you've ever had any periods where these thoughts of people working against you went away completely for at least a month, or have they been continuous since they started?

No, they haven't gone away at all. The general feeling that people were against me started slowly two years ago and has gradually worsened, but over the last couple of months, the intense belief that they are actively coordinating to ruin me has been completely continuous without any breaks.
Have you ever felt like you're in danger or that your life is being threatened by these people you believe are working against you?

I wouldn't say I've felt like my life was in direct physical danger, but I definitely haven't felt safe or welcome in certain spaces, which is why I've cut trips short and isolated myself. The constant anxiety and stress of feeling like they are coordinating to ruin me has just made it feel easier to stay hidden away. It's incredibly exhausting to carry that fear, even if it isn't a physical threat.

Have you experienced any significant impairment in social, occupational, or other areas of functioning, aside from what you've already mentioned, that you attribute to these beliefs or to any other reason?

Yes, my professional practice has taken a massive hit—I've had to cut my hours way back and have lost several long-term clients because I just can't manage it anymore. Socially, I've become almost completely isolated, barely seeing my friends or family because I constantly cancel plans or avoid any events where I think those people might show up.
Have you experienced any significant disorganized thinking or speech, or exhibited any catatonic behavior, alongside these persistent beliefs about people working against you?

No, I haven't experienced any disorganized speech, confused thinking, or unusual physical behaviors like that. My thoughts and speech feel clear to me. My main struggle is really just the constant worry about these people working together to ruin my reputation.

Can you tell me if you've ever experienced any other types of delusions, such as delusions of grandeur, being controlled, or having a special mission, beyond the belief that these specific people are working against you?

No, I've never experienced anything like that at all. I don't feel like I have any special powers, missions, or that anyone else is controlling my actions. My only concern is this specific group of people in my professional and art circles who are working to ruin my reputation.

Have you ever felt like your thoughts, feelings, or actions are being controlled or influenced by these people you believe are working against you, or is it solely the belief that they are trying to damage your reputation?

No, I don't feel like they are controlling my thoughts, feelings, or physical actions at all. It is solely the belief that they are coordinating behind my back to freeze me out of my practice and social circle. I am just convinced that there is an external plot to damage my reputation.
Can you tell me if you believe these people's actions against you are specifically aimed at you, or if you think it's part of a larger plot that just happens to involve you?

I am certain that this is specifically and personally aimed at me. I believe this specific group in my professional and art circles is actively coordinating through a private group chat or email chain to freeze me out and ruin my practice. It definitely doesn't feel like some random, larger plot; it is a targeted effort to damage my reputation.
Can you describe in more detail how you think these people's alleged actions against you are organized, and if you believe there is a leader or a specific method they use to coordinate their efforts?

I believe they use a quiet group chat or email chain to coordinate, which feels especially obvious whenever a client reschedules or a patron doesn't reply to me. I'm not sure if there is one specific leader behind it all, but I am convinced this group communication is how they organize their efforts to freeze me out and ruin my name.

You've mentioned that you believe a specific group of people is working against you, but can you tell me if you think this belief is based on any actual events or evidence that you've observed, or if it's more of a general feeling that you have?

It started as a strong gut feeling, but now I see what I believe is clear evidence, like clients suddenly rescheduling meetings or art patrons not returning my emails. I feel these are coordinated actions, like a quiet group chat or email chain meant to freeze me out. Even though others tell me I'm just overthinking these minor setbacks, to me it feels like concrete proof.

Have you ever experienced any other types of unusual or bizarre beliefs that don't involve these specific people working against you, or has it always been focused on this one idea of them ruining your reputation?

No, my concerns have been entirely focused on this specific group of people in my professional and art circles, and I haven't had any other unusual ideas unrelated to them. To me, though, this situation doesn't feel like some "unusual belief"—it feels incredibly real and has been deeply distressing.

Have you ever felt like neutral or positive events, such as seeing a friend or receiving a compliment, are actually part of the plot against you or a hidden message from the people you believe are working against you?

No, I don't really see hidden messages in compliments or things like that. It's more that when minor everyday setbacks happen—like a client rescheduling or an art patron ignoring an email—I immediately feel like it's part of their coordinated effort to freeze me out. It's a very strong, persistent feeling that I just can't seem to shake, even when others tell me I'm overthinking it.

Can you tell me if you have ever had any moments where you felt like you were receiving special messages or signals from the TV, radio, or other media that were meant just for you, even if it was just for a brief period?

No, I've never experienced anything like that. I don't get any special messages or signals from the TV, radio, or anything in the media. My concerns are strictly about the specific people in my professional and art circles.

Have you ever considered that your beliefs about these people working against you might be exaggerated or not based on reality, even if it feels very real to you, and how has this belief impacted your daily functioning and relationships?

People constantly tell me I'm overthinking it, and though I try to consider that they might be right, the feeling is just too strong to shake. Because of this, my practice has taken a massive hit with lost clients and cut hours, and I barely see my family or friends anymore since I constantly cancel plans to avoid running into those people.

Have you ever had any periods where you felt like your thoughts or actions were being broadcasted or shared with others, such as through television or radio, or that you were being controlled by some external force, which might help clarify the nature of your beliefs about people working against you?

No, I have never felt like my thoughts were being broadcasted or that I was being controlled by any external forces. My concerns are strictly focused on those specific people in my professional and art circles who are actively plotting behind my back to ruin me.

Have you ever had any brief periods where you questioned the reality of your beliefs about these people working against you, or have these beliefs always felt completely true to you without any doubt?

They have always felt completely true to me, and I've never really had a moment of doubt. Even though everyone constantly tells me I'm just overthinking it, no amount of reassurance has been able to shake this conviction. To me, it just feels like an absolute reality that they are working against me.

Have you ever experienced any other symptoms like hallucinations, disorganized speech, or catatonic behavior that lasted for a significant period, which might help distinguish between the possible causes of your beliefs about people working against you?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I've never heard voices, seen things that aren't there, had trouble speaking clearly, or felt frozen and unable to move. My struggles have really just been centered around the constant stress regarding those people in my professional and art circles.

Can you describe if there are any specific actions or events that you believe will happen if these people succeed in their alleged plot against you, and how that affects your daily life and decisions?

If they succeed, I believe they will completely freeze me out, ruin my reputation, and destroy my financial advisory practice. To protect myself, I've had to cut back my work hours, which has cost me several clients, and I now constantly cancel social plans and avoid family gatherings if I think any of those people might show up.
Have you ever believed that ordinary events or conversations of others had a special meaning or message for you, related to the plot you think is against you?

Yes, I definitely see ordinary events that way. When a client suddenly reschedules a meeting or an art patron doesn't return an email, I immediately interpret it as a deliberate sign of their coordination against me. To me, these everyday occurrences feel like concrete proof of their quiet group chat or email chain meant to freeze me out.
Have you ever believed that you have a special role or mission that is connected to the plot you think is against you, or that you are in some way extraordinary because of these beliefs?

No, I don't feel special or chosen at all, and I definitely don't have any special mission. I just feel like an ordinary person who is being targeted by these specific people trying to ruin my reputation and business. It doesn't make me feel extraordinary; it just makes me feel incredibly stressed and isolated.
Can you tell me if you believe these people's actions against you are part of a larger conspiracy involving many others, or if it's a smaller, more personal plot specifically targeting you?

It is definitely a personal, targeted plot specifically aimed at me, rather than some massive conspiracy. I believe it is just those specific clients and art patrons in my local circle who have set up a quiet group chat or email chain to coordinate freezing me out. They are focused entirely on ruining my reputation and my practice.
Can you think of any situation or event in the past where you felt like you were not being targeted by these people, or has the feeling of being targeted been constant since it started?

Well, before my breakup a little over two years ago, I didn't feel targeted at all, but after that, the general worry and suspicion slowly started to build. Over the last couple of months, though, the intense feeling that these specific people are actively coordinating against me has been completely constant. I haven't had any breaks or relief from it recently.
Can you tell me if you believe these people's alleged actions against you are something that could be proven or disproven with evidence, or if it's something you just inherently know is true?

While I see things like rescheduled meetings or unreturned emails as clear signs of their coordination, it ultimately feels like something I just inherently know is true deep down. I know others say there is no real proof and that I'm overthinking, but the feeling is just too strong for me to doubt it.
Have you ever considered seeking a second opinion or talking to someone outside of your social and professional circles about these beliefs to see if they might offer a different perspective?

No, I haven't really thought about seeking a second opinion or talking to anyone else outside of this consultation. To be honest, I'm only here today because my sister strongly pushed me to see a professional about what's been going on.
